result.title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
result.summary: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 β-Flow：一种以相关系数 β 和置信度 κ 参数化的 plug-and-play 后验采样方法，每步只需一次去噪网络前向加一步精确 Kalman 式高斯条件更新，可统一 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验，并在 4 数据集 7 个线性逆问题上取得较好表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其不依赖梯度的精确高斯条件更新，或可作为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态条件更新与证据注入的方法线索；β 所刻画的先验—似然权衡也可能对应「视觉证据可信度 vs latent 推理先验」的平衡，但用于多模态推理状态尚需核查。
